# Sofas

The Alder sofa uses a kiln-dried hardwood frame, high-resilience foam cushions, and removable polyester covers. It is 214 cm wide, 91 cm deep, and 84 cm high. Available customer colors are oat, slate, and forest green. Seat covers may be spot-cleaned with mild soap; cushion inserts must remain dry.

# Compatibility

The matching Alder ottoman is 72 by 58 cm. The sofa is not approved for outdoor use. Doorways should provide at least 78 cm clear width after removable legs are detached.
